description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region.

description.zh:
部署模式。取值说明：
- multiple：多可用区部署。
- single：单可用区部署。
description.en:
The deployment mode. Valid values:
- multiple: multi-zone deployment.
- single: single-zone deployment.

description.zh:
备可用区VSwitch ID。

> 
> - 仅多可用区部署时需传入该参数。
> - 备可用区VSwitch ID所在可用区必须与StandbyZoneId保持一致。
description.en:
The vSwitch ID in the secondary zone.

> 
> - This parameter is required only for multi-zone deployment.
> - The zone of the vSwitch specified by this parameter must be the same as the zone specified by StandbyZoneId.

description.zh:
备可用区ID。

> 
> - 仅多可用区部署时需传入该参数。
> - 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的可用区ID。
> - 备可用区ID必须与主可用区ID不一致。
description.en:
The secondary zone ID.

> 
> - This parameter is required only for multi-zone deployment.
> - You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query available zone IDs.
> - The secondary zone ID must be different from the primary zone ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-deployment-mode --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --deploy-mode multiple --standby-zone-id cn-hangzhou-j --standby-vswitch-id vsw-bp1cpq8mr64paltkb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
